description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of three language models – GPT4o and two versions of Sonnet – across three prompting strategies: “Basic prompt,” “Structured prompt + oracle,” and “Structured prompt + predicted.” The horizontal axis displays the language model names: GPT4o and Sonnet, with each model having three bars representing the different prompting strategies. The vertical axis, labeled “Value,” represents a numeric scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.7, with tick marks at 0.1 intervals. Each model has a set of three bars, colored dark blue, orange, and dark green, corresponding to the “Basic prompt,” “Structured prompt + oracle,” and “Structured prompt + predicted” strategies, respectively. For GPT4o, the “Basic prompt” bar reaches approximately 0.32, the “Structured prompt + oracle” bar reaches approximately 0.63, and the “Structured prompt + predicted” bar reaches approximately 0.56. For Sonnet, the “Basic prompt” bar reaches approximately 0.25, the “Structured prompt + oracle” bar reaches approximately 0.54, and the “Structured prompt + predicted” bar reaches approximately 0.43. The bars are grouped by language model, with each group containing one bar for each prompting strategy, arranged in the order “Basic prompt,” “Structured prompt + oracle,” and “Structured prompt + predicted.” No bars are visually emphasized, and the chart includes a legend to identify the color associated with each prompting strategy.
